name: Derived Data
detail: Build intermediates, indexes and logs. Xcode rebuilds these on the next build.

name: iOS Device Support
detail: Debug symbols copied from connected iPhones and iPads, one folder per OS build.

name: tvOS Device Support
detail: Debug symbols copied from connected Apple TVs, one folder per OS build.

name: watchOS Device Support
detail: Debug symbols copied from paired Apple Watches, one folder per OS build.

name: Documentation Cache
detail: Downloaded and indexed developer documentation. Re-fetched on demand.

name: Products & Device Logs
detail: Exported build products and crash logs pulled from devices.

name: Xcode Downloads
detail: Leftover installers and components downloaded by older Xcode versions.

name: XcodeBuildMCP Data
detail: Build artifacts and logs from the XcodeBuildMCP tooling.

name: Xcode Application Cache
detail: Xcode's own scratch cache, separate from Derived Data.

name: Device Connection Cache
detail: Staged app bundles and symbols CoreDevice keeps when running on real  devices. Rebuilt on the next run.

name: Archives
detail: Distribution builds and their dSYMs. Without these you cannot symbolicate  crash reports from versions you already shipped.

name: Simulator Caches
detail: Shared CoreSimulator caches, including dyld and image caches. No devices are  removed.

name: Test Simulator Clones
detail: Simulator clones created by parallel testing. Usually stale, and often the  single largest item on this machine.

name: Simulator Devices
detail: Your installed simulators, including any apps and data inside them.

name: Playground Devices
detail: Simulator instances backing Swift Playgrounds previews.
